title: Apple Inc. (AAPL): Charged Down Insiders Sell Shares
text:
Apple Inc. (AAPL): Charged Down Insiders Sell Shares February 5, 2019
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) is rated as Buy by analysts at UBS. The firm was pushed by the stock performance to change their PT view from $180 to $185 on January 30. Analysts at Rosenblatt, maintained the company shares at Neutral on January 30 but switched target price from $165 to $150. Brokerage firm Morgan Stanley, looks cautious as they stick to prior recommendation of Overweight, in a call on January 30. However, they did change the target price from $211 to $197. Monness Crespi & Hardt, reiterated their call for Buy, on January 30. On the other hand, they had set new target price to $220 versus $200.
Apple Inc. (AAPL) hit an intraday high Monday at $171.655. The shares finished at $171.25, after trading as low as $167.28 earlier in the session. It rose 2.84% in recent trade and currently has a stock-market value of $822.27B. Trading activity significantly weakened as the volume at ready counter decreased to 31,192,186 shares versus 35,265,113 in average daily trading volume over the past 20 days. So far this year, the volume has averaged about 38,793,965 shares. The stock is now 20.6% above against its bear-market low of $142 on January 03, 2019. It has retreated -36.33% since it’s 52-week high of $233.47 reached in October. Now the market price is up 2.07% on the year and up 8.56% YTD.
AAPL’s 50 day simple moving average (SMA 50) price is $162.21 and its 200-day simple moving average (SMA 200) price is $191.4. The company’s stock currently has a total float of 4.74B shares. Its weekly volatility is hovering around 2.69% and felt 2.3% volatility in price over a month. On the upside, the share price will test short term resistance at around $172.84. On a downside, the stock is likely to find some support, which begins at $168.47. The failure to get near-term support could push it to $165.69.
Separately, it has been reported that multiple insider activity took place at Apple Inc. (AAPL). Principal Accounting Officer Kondo Chris sold 3,408 shares for $8,940 in transaction occurred on 2018/11/19. After making this transaction, the Principal Accounting Officer owns a direct stake of 647,520 shares, worth $1,530,975, as per the last closing price. On 2018/10/05 Ahrendts Angela J, Senior Vice President at AAPL, dumped 64,194 shares at an average price of $230.89 per share. The selling total is valued at $11,361,410.
Senior Vice President, CFO, Maestri Luca had divested 100,245 shares for $27,324 through a trade on 2018/10/04. Following this activity, the insider holds 22,911,997 shares worth $4,679,235 as of recent close. Wall Street’s most bullish Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) analysts are predicting the share price to blow past $245 per share during the next 12 months. The current median share price forecast by them is $180, suggesting that the stock could increase 5.11% in that time frame. The average price target of $178.59 calls for a nearly 4.29% increase in the stock price.
When looking at valuations, Apple Inc. (AAPL) has a pricey P/E of 14.1x as compared to industry average of 6.17x. Moreover, it trades for 12.84 times the next 12 months of expected earnings. Also, it is trading at rather expensive levels at just over 7.68x price/book and 3.1x price/sales. Compared to others, Apple Inc. is in a different league with regards to profitability, having net margins of 22.4%. To put some perspective around this, the industry’s average net margin is 19.2%. AAPL’s ROE is 48.7%, which is also considerably better than the industry’s ROE of 21.76%. It’s also very liquid in the near term, with a current ratio of 1.1. The stock has a debt/capital of 1.07.
Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) have gained 7.7% since the company’s last earnings report. Over the past 12 fiscal quarters, Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has topped consensus earnings estimates in 11 quarters (91%), missed earnings in 1 quarters (8%), whereas at 0 occasion EPS met analyst expectations. AAPL last reported earnings on January 29, 2019 when it released Sep-18 results that exceeded expectations. The company raked in $2.91 per share, -37.42% change on the same period last year. That was better than consensus for $2.78. Revenue for the recent quarter stood at $62.9 billion, up 20% on last year and above the $61.56 billion predicted by analysts. For this quarter, Wall Street analysts forecast revenue in a range of $86.53 billion to $97.76 billion, which should be compared with $87.53 billion generated last year. EPS is seen in a range of $4.72 to $5.53, against the $4.21 reported a year ago.
